scope: Corollary 8.2 (Uniqueness into the characteristic-two union) of the manuscript “Fiber functors for finite symmetric tensor categories in positive characteristic” (preprints/Fiber-functors-for-finite-symmetric-tensor-categories-in-positive-characteristic-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 208 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 49778ddd4cc611b5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic two and let C be a finite symmetric tensor category over k. There is exactly one fiber functor C −→ Ver2∞ (k) up to monoidal natural isomorphism. Its isomorphism class contains a representative that factors through Ver2n (k) for some finite n ≥ 1. For each fixed n ≥ 1, there is at most one fiber functor C → Ver2n (k) up to monoidal natural isomorphism.
